The checks below follow the platform published pages in order - what it claims, what the fine print says, and where the two diverge. The verdict is a summary of those checks, nothing more.
whatItClaims: AI and algorithmic market analysis producing signals and suggested entries.
Automatic or manual execution, with a browser-based platform.
No platform fees - broker spreads and overnight charges still apply.
Payouts reportedly within a day.
12 crypto assets through broker partners.
whatWeChecked: The ownership trail: who operates the platform and where.
The support channels: live chat, email or phone availability.
The fine print: clauses that qualify the headline promises.
The fee framing: no platform fees, but spreads embedded in every trade.
The support story: around-the-clock coverage claimed, exact figures conflicting.
The geo-restrictions: two lists on the page that do not agree.

faqs.a: The page promises payouts within a day, but the processing detail is thin. Confirm the exact timeline and any fees with support before funding anything.

faqs.q: How much support does it offer?
faqs.a: Unclear - around-the-clock coverage is claimed, while other sections quote different figures. Ask support to reconcile them before you fund anything.
Yes - the platform offers automatic and manual modes, so you can follow the signals or confirm each entry yourself.
Yes - signup is free and activates through a confirmation link. The first cost is the US$300 deposit, which stays in your trading balance.

faqs.q: Does it offer a demo account?
faqs.a: Yes - a practice account is part of the package and runs alongside the live balance, which is the sensible first step before risking the US$300 minimum.

bottomLine: For a cautious newcomer, Trading Mentor Reviews can work: start on the demo, deposit the US$300 minimum and keep your own numbers.
We scored Trading Mentor Reviews 4.6 out of 5. The deductions come from the disclosure gaps, not the mechanics. With the US$300 minimum and the demo as guardrails, the risk stays yours to control.
